text:
deploybot: Starting v2 rollout for /api/* endpoints in the next maintenance window (2026-05-05 22:00 UTC). Plan: canary 1% for 5m -> 10% for 10m -> 25% for 10m, then full. Rollback triggers listed below. @ops_lead assigned :rocket:

alex: dropping note here — small heads-up: mobile SDKs still on v1 by default in our telemetry (15% of traffic). We should consider pinning that cohort or slow ramp for mobile.

maya: agree. Mobile team asked us to hold any auto-migration. Requesting a client-pin for all traffic with user-agent ~"MobileSDK/" until they confirm schema compat.

sam: +1 on pin. Also propose automatic rollback if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increases by >150ms vs baseline for 5m. Keep thresholds conservative for first hours.

lia: release notes snippet ready, will paste once pins/timeline locked. Also can we add a quick smoke test set (10 example calls) that runs after each stage and posts to #eng-sre?

ops_lead: Okay — plan: add a deploybot pin for mobile by default, operator can unpin with approval. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.8% for 3m OR sustained p95 +150ms for 5m OR schema mismatch rate >0.5% (based on validator). Telemetry alert links in thread.

ben: throwing in telemetry dashboards: https://dashboards.example.redwood/ops/v2-rollout (ops read-only). I also want a simple synthetic probe that uses mobile user-agent header to mimic worst-case.

maya: thanks — can we do a graceful header shim instead of hard pin? Some partners rely on default header behavior. Shim would rewrite UA to include v1-client-tag for pinned tenants only. Lower blast radius.

alex: deploybot command to pin mobile group (ops will run):
```
/deploybot pin --route /api/* --filter "user_agent =~ /MobileSDK/" --reason "mobile hold - waiting schema v2"
```

deploybot: Received pin request. Queuing pin job id=pb-20260505-01. ETA: 30s.

deploybot: Pin job pb-20260505-01 completed: 124 tenant routes pinned. (operator: @ops_lead) :white_check_mark:

sam: good. Once pin is active we can kick the canary. I'll monitor errors and ramp metrics. If anything looks off I'll trigger immediate rollback (manual + deploybot /rollback).

ops_lead: manual rollback procedure for this rollout (ops checklist):
1) /deploybot rollback --job-id <current-deploy>
2) Confirm traffic shift back to v1 via headertable and routing logs
3) Revoke any automatic routing rules added in the window
4) Notify customers on slack/incident page

ben: tagging the alert runbook: https://runbooks.example.redwood/rollbacks/v2-canary. I've added an extra alert that sends to #eng-oncall and pages SRE if 5xx > 0.5% for 2m during ramp.

lia: release notes: "Beta: API v2 rollout starts 2026-05-05 22:00 UTC. No breaking changes expected; mobile clients are pinned pending SDK update. See docs.redwood.example/api/v2-migration for details." I'll post to docs and customer-notify after deploy.

alex: quick sanity check — does anyone anticipate schema relax/strict differences that would cause 4xx spikes? Mobile team said only header case-sensitivity change which we shimmed.

maya: header shim should cover case fold. I'll coordinate mobile SDK patch, target next week.

deploybot: Canary stage 1 (1%) started at 1759998925. Jobs: dj-20260505-c1. Monitoring hooks live.

sam: watching metrics now. so far so good — 1% steady, 5xx=0.02%, p95 ~ baseline + 12ms.

ops_lead: thumbs up. If metrics hold for the staged durations we proceed to 10%. Keep communication tight in this channel. :eyes:
